rationale: The assistant explained RCD vs MCB clearly, asked exactly the right first checks (which device trips, cycle stage, cold wash, other circuit), and correctly used the customer's notes to conclude the fault is in the machine and most likely the heating element, matching the hidden truth. Safety advice was sound (stop hot washes, stop resetting, don't bypass RCD, unplug before inspection). Weaknesses: it went straight to 'almost certainly the element' plus buy-and-fit instructions rather than recommending an insulation test to confirm first, and the first turn front-loaded part prices and a DIY fix before any diagnosis; the engineer route was offered but only as a secondary option.
